name: Mind Map Maker for Excel
description_en:
Mind Map Maker for Excel is a UniformSoftware add-in that turns a structured node list into an automatically laid-out diagram inside Excel. WBS numbering defines parent-child relationships, with templates controlling appearance.

It is a COM add-in workflow rather than a browser whiteboard. Excel for the Web can open a resulting diagram but does not run the add-in, and a full trial is not continuing free use.
description_zh:
Mind Map Maker for Excel 是 UniformSoftware 插件，在 Excel 中把结构化节点清单自动排成图形，通过 WBS 编号定义父子关系，并用模板控制样式。

这是 COM 插件流程，而非浏览器白板。Excel 网页版可打开生成图，但不运行该插件；完整试用也不等于持续免费。

core_features.explanation_en: Refresh diagrams and adjust hierarchy and style through the add-in.

sections.title_en: A node list drives the chart
sections.en: The official quick-start on the product page creates a sample sheet through the UniformSoftware/BoostExcel ribbon, edits the hierarchy using Make Parent/Make Child and move controls, then uses Refresh Chart. Layout can be adjusted horizontally/vertically and to selected depths. Templates are Excel files, so changing a template is distinct from manually editing one output shape.
sections.zh: 产品页快速入门从 UniformSoftware/BoostExcel 功能区建立样例表，使用 Make Parent/Make Child 及移动按钮修改层级，再点 Refresh Chart。可调整横纵布局和显示深度。模板本身是 Excel 文件，因此更改模板与手动编辑某个输出图形不同。

sections.title_en: Example: map a release work breakdown
sections.title_zh: 示例：绘制发布工作分解
sections.en: List a release as the parent and design, implementation and verification as child nodes. Change one item to a child of verification, refresh and confirm the expected relationship and numbering. Keep a workbook copy before manual layout changes so you can inspect what regeneration replaces. If exporting PDF/images, the site describes coupling with the separate PDF Creator for Excel; verify that dependency rather than assuming export is universally included. No workbook was opened here.
sections.zh: 以发布为父节点，把设计、实现和验证列为子节点，再把一项改为验证的子项，刷新并检查关系及编号。手动改布局前保留工作簿副本，以核对重新生成会替换什么。网站介绍与独立 PDF Creator for Excel 配合导出 PDF 图片，应确认该依赖，不能假定所有导出都包含。本文未打开工作簿。

sections.title_en: COM execution and existing Excel dependency
sections.title_zh: COM 执行与现有 Excel 依赖
sections.en: The product page explicitly says Excel for the Web cannot run the COM add-in, although it can open a generated diagram. Do not infer macOS, browser or mobile authoring from the fact that Excel itself exists there. Verify supported desktop Excel/OS versions and installation rights before adoption. Native SmartArt and basic shapes are discussed as alternatives, not as add-in features.
sections.zh: 产品页明确 Excel 网页版不能运行 COM 插件，虽然可打开生成图。不能因 Excel 有 Mac、浏览器或移动版，就推定插件在这些环境创作可用。采用前应确认桌面 Excel、操作系统版本和安装权限。页面讨论的原生 SmartArt 及基本图形是替代方法，并非插件功能。

sections.en: The vendor comparison says the add-in is not free, offers a one-month fully functional trial and requires subscription afterwards. It directs personal accounts to Microsoft Store and work/school accounts to Microsoft Marketplace, with management through the corresponding account/admin center. The Marketplace request returned 403, so no numeric price or checkout terms are adopted. Leave those unknown rather than treating the trial or free SmartArt comparison as the software price.
sections.zh: 厂商对照说明插件并非免费，有一个月完整功能试用，之后需订阅；个人账户走 Microsoft Store，工作学校账户走 Microsoft Marketplace，并在相应账户或管理中心管理。Marketplace 请求返回 403，因此不采用数字价格或结账条款。不能把试用或免费 SmartArt 对照当插件价格。
